title: Drop impls that expect/unwrap a non-state mutex can double-panic and abort the process if that mutex is poisoned
outcome: Drop impls that expect/unwrap a non-state mutex can double-panic and abort the process if that mutex is poisoned
acceptance: Each listed Drop implementation either recovers a poisoned lock (PoisonError::into_inner) or otherwise never panics while the thread is unwinding, preserving its existing bookkeeping; no other behaviour changes.

Where a mutex can realistically be poisoned, a regression shows dropping the guard after poisoning neither panics nor leaves its bookkeeping inconsistent; the review pair finds no Medium or higher and the full gate passes on the exact landed tree.
